fields.name: fields[1].content
fields.label: Date of birth
fields.gotcha: visible input #fields1content is READONLY jQuery-UI datepicker showing DD.MM.YYYY; the POSTed value lives in hidden fields[1].content and MUST be ISO yyyy-mm-dd — the site's own onSelect converts dd.mm.yyyy -> yyyy-mm-dd before writing the hidden. Writing DD.MM.YYYY into the hidden bounces the submit with a misleading 'Format dd.mm.yyyy' error (proven live on Kanton 2026-08-19). Fill BOTH halves, each in its own format.
